Marissa — thanks for the heads up and for using the template. High level: this approach looks appropriate and measured. A couple of quick items from People: 

- Please avoid language that implies determinative next steps ("will be terminated if"). Frame outcomes as dependent on demonstrated improvement and remediation opportunities.
- Make the goals time-bound and observable (e.g., "deliver postmortem action items within 5 business days" vs "improve responsiveness").
- Evidence log: ask Jorge to acknowledge receipt of meeting notes; keep interactions documented.

I'm looping in Jenna (external employment counsel) for a quick compliance read because Jorge has been with Redwood for 6+ years and we want to minimize legal exposure. Jenna — would you scan the attached PIP_Template_v2 and flag any wording we should adjust for state employment law (CA)?

Also: we should make the initial meeting a "support conversation" rather than "formal PIP" in language; send the formal written plan after the calibration call with People & Legal.

If you can, please upload the draft to the Confluence PIP page (link below) and I'll add HR checklist items. I'll also open a confidential case file in the HR system.

Marissa / Laura / team — thanks for the context and the updated draft. A few concise notes from counsel: 

1) "Co-sign" for acknowledgement is fine if framed as receipt/confirmation of discussion, not as consent to disciplinary action. Keep the acknowledgement language to: "I acknowledge I received and discussed this support plan with my manager."

2) Avoid absolute timelines that create automatic triggers (e.g., "failure to meet X will result in termination"). Instead: "If objectives are not met, management will evaluate next steps which may include role changes or separation."

3) Document coaching & reasonable accommodations if raised. If Jorge references any disability or accommodation, pause the timeline and loop People immediately.

4) Retention: keep the evidence log and related notes in the confidential HR case file; limit access to manager / People / Legal.

I can redline the PIP_Template_v2 and return it by EOD Monday if you'd like. If you expect a high-sensitivity reaction, consider having a People partner join the initial 1:1.

Best,
Jenna Kline

R&L Counsel (external)
